title: UBI Software
short_description: A Linux desktop dashboard for exploring managed UBI operations, organizational workflows, and intervention tracking.

body_sections.heading: About this project
paragraphs: UBI Software is a desktop-oriented application for exploring how a managed UBI platform might look and behave as real software.

Instead of presenting the idea as a design document alone, the project turns it into an interactive application with local persistence, workflow screens, operational dashboards, and native Linux packaging.
The current itch.io upload targets the Linux channel for users who want to inspect the working prototype locally.

body_sections.heading: Included in the current build
bullets: Overview, estate, presence, leadership, and operations screens
Local JSON-backed persistence for company, employee, and intervention data
Local API endpoints for company, workspace, employee, and intervention workflows
Native Linux packaging with a launcher script for the itch.io build
Existing screenshot assets suitable for the page gallery

body_sections.heading: Who it is for
bullets: Developers interested in Blazor-based desktop tooling

body_sections.heading: Why this stands out
paragraphs: UBI Software is not just a whitepaper or static mockup. It is a functioning local application with data flow, screens, persistence, and packaging work already in place.
That makes it a better fit for people who want to inspect an implementation direction, interact with a working interface, and evaluate the operational framing as software.

body_sections.heading: Scope note
paragraphs: This is best presented as a prototype or simulation environment, not as a real financial product or production deployment system.

body_sections.heading: AI disclosure
paragraphs: UBI Software is a working desktop software prototype developed through direct implementation and iteration. Any AI-assisted work supported development tasks but does not replace the authored application logic, workflows, or packaging.
